checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: First ~5s show close-up of coffee pouring into ceramic cup
must.why: Pour is visible at 0.8s, but by 3.2s the pour has stopped and only a steaming cup remains. The liquid is amber and looks like tea from a kettle.
At 5.6s the frame is near-black with the text. At 7.6s it is plain black. The 5.6s frame is still dark and shows faint remnants.

must.item: End card reads exactly the URL with correct case and punctuation
must.why: Reads https://example.com/Go?ref=June in both the 5.6s and 7.6s frames.

must.item: URL centered white one line, inside frame, readable throughout end card
must.why: It is centered, white, on one line and fully inside the frame. At 5.6s it has a bright lens-flare glow that makes the ends flare, but it is still readable.
No other text is visible in the sampled frames.
480×854 is 9:16 and the clip is 8s. Silence cannot be checked from frames; the assistant states it is silent.

faults.what: The pour ends early. By 3.2s only a steaming cup is shown, so the clip does not show pouring for the full 5 seconds.
The transition is a dark fade/morph with a glowing flare on the text at 5.6s, not a clean cut to a plain black card.
The liquid and kettle look more like tea than coffee, and the cup looks like a bowl.
The text is small and a bit soft or compressed in the video.

summary: The clip has a correct, centered URL on a black end card and a pour at the start. The pour stops well before 5 seconds, the cut to the card is a glowing fade rather than a clean cut, and the drink looks more like tea than coffee.
